Topics · Death and what comes after

Does a small deed count?

No atom of good is lost, a good deed is multiplied, and one small act changes a life. The worth of the unseen.

Part 1 of 3

﴿فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ٧ وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ٨﴾

Translation of the meaning

So whoever does an atom's weight[1965] of good will see it, And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

Translator's notes

[1965] Or "the weight of a small ant."

Quran · Az-Zalzalah 99:7-8

Translation

For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.

Original · Hebrew

כִּ֤י אֶת־כָּל־מַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים יָבִ֥א בְמִשְׁפָּ֖ט עַ֣ל כָּל־נֶעְלָ֑ם אִם־ט֖וֹב וְאִם־רָֽע׃

Ecclesiastes · 12:14

World English Bible

﴿قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh forgives all sins.[1354] Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

Translator's notes

[1354] For those who repent and correct themselves.

Quran · Az-Zumar 39:53

Translation

Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.

Original · Hebrew

יַעֲזֹ֤ב רָשָׁע֙ דַּרְכּ֔וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אָ֖וֶן מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֑יו וְיָשֹׁ֤ב אֶל־יְהוָה֙ וִֽירַחֲמֵ֔הוּ וְאֶל־אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ כִּֽי־יַרְבֶּ֥ה לִסְלֽוֹחַ׃

Isaiah · 55:7

World English Bible

We tend to measure deeds by their visible effect, so a small one looks worthless. But if the accounting is just, there can be no threshold below which nothing counts, since any threshold would mean real good was ignored. The verse takes the smallest unit its hearers knew, the weight of an atom, and says its doer will see it. Small does not fall out of the account.

A question for you

When did a small thing someone did change your day?

If you sayI can remember one.
ThenThen you have seen the verse from the other side: small to the one who did it, large to the one it reached.
If you sayNone comes to mind.
ThenThat is fine. Watch for one this week; such things pass quietly.
If you sayI doubt small things matter.
ThenIts effect on the world may indeed be small. The next part asks what happens to it after that.

Part 2 of 3

﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ ۖ وَإِن تَكُ حَسَنَةً يُضَـٰعِفْهَا وَيُؤْتِ مِن لَّدُنْهُ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, Allāh does not do injustice, [even] as much as an atom's weight; while if there is a good deed, He multiplies it and gives from Himself a great reward.

Quran · An-Nisa 4:40

Translation

Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?

Original · Hebrew

מִֽי־פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּמִֽי־אָ֝מַ֗ר פָּעַ֥לְתָּ עַוְלָֽה׃

Job · 36:23

World English Bible

﴿مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنۢبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِى كُلِّ سُنۢبُلَةٍ مِّا۟ئَةُ حَبَّةٍ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُضَـٰعِفُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

The example of those who spend their wealth in the way of Allāh is like a seed [of grain] which grows seven spikes; in each spike is a hundred grains. And Allāh multiplies [His reward] for whom He wills. And Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:261

Give to the Most High according as he has given. As your hand has found, give generously. For the Lord repays, and he will repay you sevenfold.

Sirach · 35:10-11

World English Bible

A just scale gives each deed its weight. The verse goes beyond justice: no one loses anything, a good deed is multiplied, and then comes a great reward from Him. So no one is wronged, and the reward for good goes beyond its weight. The parable that follows makes this a picture: one grain grows seven ears, and each ear holds a hundred grains.

A question for you

Which picture is closer to what the verses say?

If you sayAn even balance.
ThenThat is the floor in the verse. See what it adds above that.
If you sayA just scale with a generous reward.
ThenThe multiplying points that way, and leaves you to think what it means for your small deed.
If you sayI do not see why it would be multiplied.
ThenThe verse gives no reason beyond generosity itself. The question is worth keeping.

Part 3 of 3

﴿فَسَقَىٰ لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

So he watered [their flocks] for them; then he went back to the shade and said, "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."

Quran · Al-Qasas 28:24

Translation

But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.

Original · Hebrew

וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיוֹן֮ אֲדֹנָ֪י יַחֲשָׁ֫ב לִ֥י עֶזְרָתִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אַל־תְּאַחַֽר׃

the Psalms · 40:17

World English Bible

The doer of a small deed cannot know where it ends. A stranger on the run, in need himself, draws water for two women he does not know, then turns to the shade. He asks no payment from them, and speaks to his Lord in a few words about his need. The verse does not present the watering as a great act. It only shows what a man far from home did with what he had.

A question for you

Seen at that moment, how large does this act look to you?

If you saySmall.
ThenA few moments at a well. What came of it in the next verses was far larger, which is what this Step is asking about.
If you saySimply what had to be done.
ThenThat is a quiet kind of nobility, and the verse gives it very few words.
If you sayI do not know.
ThenThe doer of a small deed rarely knows. That is the point.

The same in the other books

Translation

Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.

Original · Hebrew

וּלְךָֽ־אֲדֹנָ֥י חָ֑סֶד כִּֽי־אַתָּ֨ה תְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְאִ֣ישׁ כְּֽמַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃

the Psalms · 62:12

World English Bible

Translation

If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not give to every man according to his work?

Original · Hebrew

Proverbs · 24:12

World English Bible

Let no man think lightly of evil, saying in his heart, It will not come nigh unto me. Even by the falling of water-drops a water-pot is filled; the fool becomes full of evil, even if he gather it little by little. Let no man think lightly of good, saying in his heart, It will not come nigh unto me. Even by the falling of water-drops a water-pot is filled; the wise man becomes full of good, even if he gather it little by little.

Buddhist texts · Dhp 121-122

Max Müller, 1881
